Pager_LCD.note: the LCD, 20 x 4 characters of 5 x 7 dots: M_Pager_LCD (lit: green backlight, a sample list) / M_Pager_LCD_Off (in the file); its own texture 124 x 40, UV 0..1 (u right, v up) - the game draws its own list into it (cells 6 x 9 px from (2, 2))

Pager_Key_Up.note: up: the previous message (the game: arrow up / wheel); pushes in 1.2 mm

Pager_Key_Read.note: read: open the picked message on the screen / back (the game: E); pushes in 1.2 mm

Pager_Key_Down.note: down: the next message (the game: arrow down / wheel); pushes in 1.2 mm

Pager_LED.note: the message LED: M_Pager_LEDR (blinks while a message is unread) / M_Pager_LED_Off (in the file)

Pager_Switch.note: the alert switch on the top: 0 = BEEP (left), 0.003 = VIB (right); silent is in the pager's menu

Item_Pager.note: the worker's pager (root): standing on its bottom, origin under its middle; the front (LCD, keys) to -y, the belt clip on the left side (-x); raised in the LEFT hand to pick a message, the message itself is printed on the screen by the game

Hand_Pager.note: the left hand's grip: the lower body, the thumb on the keys

Screen.note: the LCD centre, its normal and up: where the game aims the raised pager at the eye

LED.note: a tiny red point light while the LED blinks (optional)

Belt.note: the clip on the belt: worn at the hip when lowered

meta.frame: the root in its own frame: z up, the front (LCD, keys) -y; origin on the surface it stands on (z = 0) under its middle. Every pivot / pos here is in the root's frame; FBX with the root at the origin
meta.unity: position (x, y, z) -> Unity (-x, z, -y) in the prefab; axis likewise; angle -> -angle (Unity is left-handed); box centre likewise, size (sx, sy, sz) -> (sx, sz, sy); the root's front (-y) is the prefab's +Z
meta.colliders: BoxCollider per entry on its parent: center / size in the parent's own frame, centerUnity / sizeUnity the same in Unity axes. The COL_ objects are in the .blend for reference (collection Colliders), not in the FBX
meta.mass: mass_kg on the root: a suggestion for the rigidbody
meta.materials: M_Pager_Small: the baked PSX atlas (point filter) of the body, keys, switch, clip; M_Pager_Panel: the printed faces (the front with the bezel, key signs and maker line, the side's inventory sticker, the top's BEEP / VIB) - another material on the body; M_Pager_LCD / M_Pager_LCD_Off: the screen lit (green backlight, a sample list) / off - lit in the file; own texture, UV 0..1, the game replaces it with its list; M_Pager_LEDR / M_Pager_LED_Off: the message LED (off in the file)
meta.names: the root is Item_Pager as forest_items' / forest_gear's items; parts and sockets start with Pager_
